description: Discounted cash flow valuation engine. Choose a method and supply its exact inputs to value a business from projected free cash flows, dividends, residual income, or economic profit. Covers FCFF/FCFE DCF, NPV/IRR, terminal values, and multi-stage growth. Use this for going-concern cash-flow businesses; for asset-anchored or financial firms use calculate_residual, for peer-based pricing use calculate_market_multiple, and for pre-profit companies use calculate_loss_making_company. Methods: dcf/npv: cash_flows, discount_rate; annuity: payment, discount_rate, periods; growing_annuity: payment, discount_rate, growth_rate, periods; perpetuity: payment, discount_rate; terminal_gordon: final_cash_flow, discount_rate, perpetual_growth; terminal_multiple: final_cash_flow, exit_multiple; viu_pre_tax: cash_flows, pre_tax_discount_rate; rnpv: cash_flows, discount_rate, probabilities; lease_pv: lease_payments, incremental_borrowing_rate. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

cash_flows.description: Projected cash flows in reporting currency, indexed t=1..n.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

exit_multiple.description: Exit multiple on the final flow, e.g. 8.0 for 8x.

final_cash_flow.description: Final-period cash flow for the terminal value.

growth_rate.description: Periodic growth rate as a decimal (0.03 = 3%).

lease_payments.description: Contractual lease payments in reporting currency, t=1..n.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

payment.description: Level periodic payment in reporting currency.

perpetual_growth.description: Gordon growth rate (decimal); strictly below discount_rate.

pre_tax_discount_rate.description: Pre-tax discount rate (decimal), required by viu_pre_tax (IAS 36).

probabilities.description: Cumulative success probability per period in [0,1], aligned with cash_flows.

name: calculate_dcf

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Discounted cash flow valuation
